name: Jina DeepResearch (node-DeepResearch)
description: Agent that keeps searching, reading pages and reasoning until it finds an answer or exhausts its token budget.
whatItDoes: Answers hard factual questions by iterating over web search and page reading. It deliberately targets short, correct answers rather than long reports, and suits developers who want a self-hosted deep-search endpoint.
howItWorks: A loop chooses between searching, visiting a URL, reflecting and answering, and stops when an answer passes evaluation or the budget runs out. Search and page reading use Jina's Reader API; the reasoning model is Gemini, OpenAI or a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It can be run per query from the command line or as a server exposing an OpenAI-style chat completions API.

requirements.name: LLM_PROVIDER
requirements.description: Set to openai for OpenAI or local models

models: Gemini, OpenAI, or local OpenAI-compatible models
